biography.value:
Description

King behemoths resembles yellow huge bulls with overly developed muscles. They have yellow carapaces and curved obsidian horns. Their eyes crackle with florescent energy, as they froth violently at the mouth.

Defense

AC 33, touch 15; flat-footed 26 (+18 natural, +7 dex, -2 size)

hp 409 [504] (21d10+294)

mp 132

Fort +25, Ref +19, Will +12

DR 10/adamantine; Immune bleed, curse, daze, death effects, mind-affecting, nauseating, sickening, stagger, stun; Resist ice/earth/lightning 10, shadow 5; SR 27

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee Bite +35 (2d6+15), 2 Claws +34 (1d10+15), Gore +34 (2d6+15)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Heave, Impale, Shockwave, Thunderbolt

Special Abilities Mighty Guard

Spells Known (FC CL 21st, Concentration +26)

3rd (DC 18) - Blizzara, Thundara

5th (DC 20) - Blizzaga, Thundaga

6th (DC 21) - Cometra, Flare

9th (DC 24) - Meteor

Statistics

Str 40, Dex 24, Con 36, Int 6, Wis 20, Cha 8

Base Atk +21; CMB +38; CMD 55

Feats Alertness, Charge Through, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Natural Attack (Claw), Improved Overrun, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Acrobatics +20, Climb +27, Perception +22, Survival +18

SQ Beatdown, Counter Magic, Death befalls Meteor

description.value: Whenever struck by a melee attack, as an attack of opportunity, the king behemoth will return one claw strike at (+34) 2d10+30 points of damage.

effect: Whenever struck by a melee attack, as an attack of opportunity, the king behemoth will return one claw strike at (+34) 2d10+30 points of damage.

description.value: Whenever struck by a spell, the king behemoth will cast Meteor as an immediate action as long as he has MP and is not unable to cast it like the status effect silence. This can only be used once per round.

effect: Once per round when struck by a spell. Cast the owned Meteor spell and pay its MP; requires ability to cast.

description.value: Once a king behemoth reaches below 0 health, the king behemoth calls forth a Meteor (DC 25 Reflex save) on who ever struck the killing blow. If silenced or berserk this affect does nothing.

effect: Below 0 HP only; fails while silenced or berserk. Meteor requires outdoors. Center 20 feet: maximized damage and Evasion reduced one step.
Below 0 HP only; fails while silenced or berserk. Meteor requires outdoors. Center 20 feet: maximized damage and Evasion reduced one step.

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds, the king behemoth can throw a grabbed opponent of Large or smaller size into the air by making a successful grapple check; once thrown, the opponent takes 3d6 points of falling damage, plus an additional 1d6 points of damage for each size category smaller than Large the opponent is (for example, a Medium-sized creature would be 1 category smaller than Large, & therefore would take 4d6 falling damage); this is a standard action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

effect: Grapple check; no attack of opportunity. On success resolve falling damage by size.
Recharge [[1d3]] rounds.

description.value: When charging, a king behemoth deals double damage with horns.

effect: Double gore damage on a charge; apply normal charge attack and AC modifiers separately.

description.value: A king behemoth can create a magical barrier around itself and its nearby allies, granting Protect and Shell that lasts 5 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

effect: A king behemoth can create a magical barrier around itself and its nearby allies, granting Protect and Shell that lasts 5 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds, a king behemoth can cause the ground to quake that ripples from it within a 30-ft.-radius spread. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage, inflicted with the Weighted status effect, and are pushed back 5 feet per 10 damage sustained. A successful Reflex save (DC 25) reduces damage by half, negates the status effect, and stops being pushed back. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

effect: Failure: push 5 feet per 10 damage sustained and inflict Weighted (duration unspecified).
Recharge [[1d3]] rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds, a king behemoth can discharge a large lightning storm within 120 ft. and in a 40-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 10d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with Static status effect for 1d4 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 25) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
